name: Kuresaki Gakuen's Story
source: The protagonist's parents are going on a month-long trip abroad to celebrate their wedding anniversary, leaving the protagonist at home with his sister-in-law Asuka, who is six months younger than him. A special month begins in which the protagonist lives alone with Asuka, and interacts with Aya, the protagonist's childhood friend, and Maiko, a senior who he admires.
